clint.1: I found this while working.^It's not much, but... you can have it.^ ^-Clint
clint.2: I had this lying around the shop.^I figured you might be able to use it better than I can.^ ^-Clint
clint.3: I've been spending a lot of time at the forge lately.^Working helps clear my head.^ ^I ended up with some extra materials.^Maybe they'll come in handy for you.^ ^-Clint
clint.4: I made this myself.^It took a bit of effort, but it turned out solid.^ ^I don't usually share my work like this, but...^I think you'll get some use out of it.^ ^-Clint
clint.5: I don't really celebrate things like this.^Still... I wanted to give you something.^ ^It's strange, but working feels a little less lonely lately.^ ^-Clint
clint.6: I've been experimenting with Fire Quartz.^It holds heat longer than I expected.^^So I tried applying that to something more practical.^Maybe it'll help keep your place warm.^ ^I don't usually make things like this for people.^But... I didn't mind doing it this time.^ ^-Clint
clint.7: Storms have been rough lately.^I worry about the equipment holding up.^^This should help you deal with that.^Better to be prepared than caught off guard.^ ^...You've been doing well, by the way.^ ^-Clint
clint.8: Going deeper into the mines gets dangerous.^Even with experience, things can turn quickly.^ ^Take these. They should make things easier.^^I don't say this often, but...^I'm glad someone is putting all this work to good use.^ ^-Clint
clint.9: You've come a long way since you first arrived.^It's... impressive.^ ^I don't meet many people who stick with things this long.^ ^So, here. Something to help you keep going.^ ^-Clint
clint.10: I made this for you.^Took me longer than I'd like to admit to get it right.^ ^Most of what I make stays in the shop.^But this... I wanted you to have it.^ ^It's good work. Some of my best, actually.^ ^...Thanks for sticking around.^ ^-Clint
